description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class AbstractLiveCommand, which implements the LiveCommand interface. It provides common functionality for all live command classes by wrapping a Command object and exposing methods for resource path, manifest, headers, type, JSON serialization, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: AbstractLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract base implementation for all LiveCommand types, providing common functionalities such as resource path, manifest, headers, type, JSON conversion, and equality checks.

methods.name: AbstractLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command wrapper, checking that the command is not null.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path associated with this command.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string associated with this command.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the Ditto headers associated with this command.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the command.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JSON object according to the provided schema version and predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type and the wrapped command object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the wrapped command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command, mainly for debugging.
